description: Checks lip-movement to audio alignment to detect lip-sync deepfakes and dubbing.

known_failure_modes.effect: not applicable — must be excluded by orchestrator rules, cannot run
handled gracefully via sliding window guardrail, returns not_applicable rather than an error
zero lip sequences extracted, returns not_applicable
lip sync analysis skipped gracefully, returns not_applicable

reliability_notes: Only meaningful for video with a clear, unoccluded face and audio track; never call on silent, audio-only, dark, or occluded-face inputs — the detector itself returns not_applicable in these cases rather than a misleading score.
